nodes.description: Owner address in BotProtected, assigned tx.origin in the WrappedSienna constructor.
External Ferrum bot-protection contract addressed by checkBots and list via raw low-level call.
Uniswap V2 pair address computed in the constructor from wETH and the token itself.
Public token balance mapping of WrappedSienna, mutated without SafeMath.
Public nested allowance mapping of WrappedSienna, mutated without SafeMath.
Total supply of WrappedSienna (66666000000000000000000) used in list distribution math.
Uniswap V2 router instance hard-coded to 0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D.
WETH token address used when computing the Uniswap pair.
Private _balances mapping of the abstract ERC20 reference implementation.
Private _allowances mapping of the abstract ERC20 reference implementation.
Private _totalSupply of the abstract ERC20 reference implementation.
BotProtected constructor storing the bot-protection address.
checkBots modifier performing an arbitrary low-level call to protectionFromBots before the guarded body.
SafeMath.add with overflow require.
SafeMath.sub overloads with underflow require.
SafeMath.mul with overflow require.
SafeMath.div with zero-division require.
Reference ERC20 transfer delegating to _transfer for msg.sender.
Reference ERC20 transferFrom using SafeMath on allowance.
Reference ERC20 approve delegating to _approve.
Internal ERC20 _transfer mutating balances with SafeMath.
Internal ERC20 _mint increasing total supply and balance.
Internal ERC20 _burn decreasing balance and total supply.
Internal ERC20 _approve writing the allowance mapping.
WrappedSienna constructor: sets owner to tx.origin, computes uniPair and grants infinite self/router and origin/pair allowances.
Payable transfer that forwards msg.sender to transferFrom.
Payable transferFrom guarded by checkBots; performs unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic.
Payable approve writing the caller's allowance without checks.
Owner-only arbitrary delegatecall executing attacker-supplied bytecode in this contract context.
Deterministic Uniswap V2 pair address computation via CREATE2 keccak inputs.
Owner-only listing: sets balances, adds liquidity with block.timestamp deadline, then bulk-distributes balances after external calls.
Caller-controlled msg.sender used for allowance, owner checks and approvals.
block.timestamp used as the liquidity deadline in list.
tx.origin used as the owner and as the allowance holder in the constructor.
a.delegatecall(b) executing fully attacker-controlled bytecode with this contract's storage.
Low-level protectionFromBots.call with raw selector 0x15274141 executed inside the checkBots modifier, before state updates.
Low-level protectionFromBots.call with raw selector 0xd5eaf4c3 inside list, ignoring the returned success flag.
External routerForUniswap.addLiquidityETH call forwarding ETH with a timestamp-based deadline.
Raw unchecked subtraction of allowance and of balanceOf[_from] in transferFrom (no SafeMath).
_from address used for allowance and balance checks in transferFrom.
_to recipient credited in transferFrom.
_value amount moved and subtracted in transferFrom.
Target address a of the delegatecall in delegate.
Raw calldata b executed through delegatecall in delegate.
_numList token amount set as this contract's balance and used for liquidity.
_reallyGoHere recipient array passed to the bot-protection call and credited in a loop.
_amounts array directly assigned to balanceOf of each recipient.
Local pair address returned by pairFor.
tokenA input of pairFor.
tokenB input of pairFor.
_spender approved in approve.
_value allowance written in approve.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the sender argument from transfer into transferFrom.
transfer simply returns the result of transferFrom.
transferFrom is guarded by the checkBots modifier, which runs before the function body.
The low-level bot-protection call in checkBots executes before allowance/balance state updates in transferFrom, allowing external re-entry.
protectionFromBots.call inside list re-enters before the distribution loop finishes writing balances.
addLiquidityETH is an external call made while list state is only partially updated.
The checkBots modifier executes the raw protectionFromBots call.
list reaches the protectionFromBots low-level call before the distribution loop.
list invokes addLiquidityETH on the Uniswap router.
delegate performs an arbitrary delegatecall after only an owner check.
User-supplied address a becomes the delegatecall target (backdoor execution).
User-supplied bytes b become the delegatecall payload executed in this contract context.
owner is set to tx.origin and tx.origin also receives an infinite pair allowance.
Liquidity deadline is block.timestamp + 600, making the call timestamp dependent.
delegate is gated solely by require(msg.sender == owner).
list is gated solely by require(msg.sender == owner).
msg.sender is used as spender to check and decrement allowance[_from][msg.sender].
WrappedSienna constructor invokes the BotProtected base constructor.
uniPair is assigned the result of pairFor during construction.
transferFrom performs unchecked allowance and balance subtractions without SafeMath.
Unchecked arithmetic directly mutates balanceOf balances.
list writes balanceOf[address(this)], balanceOf[msg.sender] and each recipient balance.
totalSupply * 6 / 100 is used to compute the owner's share in list.
protectionFromBots address is the target of the low-level call in checkBots.
protectionFromBots address is the target of the low-level call in list.
owner state variable is the sole authorization for delegate.
owner state variable is the sole authorization for list.
_from parameter drives allowance and balance checks in transferFrom.
_to parameter is the recipient credited in transferFrom.
_value parameter is subtracted from allowance and balance in transferFrom.
_numList is supplied as the token amount to addLiquidityETH.
_reallyGoHere array is encoded into the raw bot-protection call in list.
_amounts entries are assigned verbatim to balanceOf in list.
_reallyGoHere recipients are credited in the list distribution loop.
tokenA is ordered and hashed inside pairFor.
tokenB is ordered and hashed inside pairFor.
pair computed by pairFor is stored into uniPair by the constructor.
_spender parameter becomes the approved spender in approve.
_value parameter becomes the allowance amount in approve.
msg.sender is the allowance owner written by approve.
Reference ERC20 transfer calls internal _transfer.
Reference ERC20 transferFrom calls internal _transfer.
Reference ERC20 transferFrom re-approves the reduced allowance via _approve.
_transfer debits and credits the ERC20 _balances mapping with SafeMath.
_approve writes the ERC20 _allowances mapping.
_mint increases _totalSupply and balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply and balances.
_transfer relies on SafeMath.sub for balance arithmetic.
_mint relies on SafeMath.add for supply arithmetic.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _from only exists to feed the allowance/balance logic of transferFrom.
Parameter _to is solely the recipient of the transferFrom balance update.
Parameter _value is the amount manipulated by transferFrom unchecked arithmetic.
Parameter a is only the owner-controlled delegatecall target inside delegate.
Parameter b is the raw payload consumed directly by the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Parameter _numList only parametrizes the liquidity/balance setup of list.
Parameter _reallyGoHere is only consumed by the distribution routine of list.
Parameter _amounts is only consumed as balance values inside list.
Local pair is the sole return value produced by pairFor.
Parameter tokenA is only input to the pairFor address computation.
Parameter tokenB is only input to the pairFor address computation.
Parameter _spender is only written into the allowance mapping by approve.
Parameter _value is only written into the allowance mapping by approve.
